detail.contract: header: magic(4) envelopeVersion(4) manifestLength(8), big endian and hand written; then the cereal-encoded EnvelopeManifest, its fnv1a64 checksum(8), and the component payloads. Hand-written bytes are declared and probed, not derived.
Lua payloads are dynamic tables encoded by scripts/lib/data_codec.lua; no schema is declared, so a payload change is outside mechanical detection and must advance the version by hand.
